executionMetadata.benchmarkProtocol: fixed synthetic evidence packets; real NewsClaw SSE and configured model route; responseFormat=json_object; native provider constraint plus server contract event plus independent strict adjudication plus deterministic field truth table
executionMetadata.toolChoiceExecutionSemantics: required/function constrains the initial assistant action once; after the tool response NewsClaw uses toolChoice=none for the terminal JSON-object generation
executionMetadata.toolChoiceEvidenceBoundary: required-tool cases request function:ai_news_event and forbidden-tool cases request none. Their tool metrics measure provider-enforced orchestration plus NewsClaw executor correctness, not autonomous model tool selection.
executionMetadata.sampling: all 30 frozen cases are executed sequentially once per run
executionMetadata.privacy: synthetic prompts only; raw SSE is written to target and excluded from Git
executionMetadata.humanReviewEvidenceBoundary: humanReviewRequested is the model's controlled explanatory decision; deterministic backend review-task creation, reopening, resolution, and production gating are established by policy/service tests, not by this label

limitations: This is an online controlled benchmark, not a human-labeled sample of production user traffic.
It measures fixed evidence-policy decisions, the requested JSON-object transport contract, provider-enforced read-only tool orchestration, and run-level latency only.
The v3 toolChoice policy constrains required and forbidden tool calls; its tool metrics must not be reported as autonomous model tool-selection accuracy.
humanReviewRequested measures the model response against a frozen label; it is not evidence that a persisted backend review task was created or resolved.
It does not establish open-web discovery accuracy, hallucination rate, user satisfaction, delivery success, QPS, capacity, SLA, or token cost in production.
